not-found.title: This page doesn't exist
not-found.description: Nothing in Solyx lives at this address.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.empty: Search a symbol, then add it from above its chart.

heat-map.title: Today's moves
heat-map.description: Holdings are sized by market value and watched listings share their part equally. The deeper the colour, the bigger the move; it is full at ±5%.
heat-map.empty: Add listings to your watchlist or hold some, and their moves today show here.

sectors.title: Listed sectors
sectors.description: Each tile is a TWSE sector index, sized by the value traded today. The colour is how far the index moved; it is full at ±3%.
sectors.unavailable: Set up a market data source in Settings to see the sectors.

chart.setup-required: Set up {{source}} in Settings to load this chart.

news.title: News and posts

gauge.hint: News and posts collected over the last {{days}} days, scored by the decisions model; 50 is neutral. Press covers filings and news, crowd covers forums and social networks. Items with the same title, such as reprints and replies, count as one story.
gauge.unscored: Set up a decisions model to score sentiment

coverage.missing: What it would have found since may be missing. Automatic collection retries a source that keeps failing every few hours; asking the agent tries it right away.

news.empty: Nothing collected in the last 7 days. News is collected at the interval set in Settings, or when you ask the agent.

agent.title: Agent
agent.delete-description: Its messages are erased from this computer and can't be restored. Proposals it made stay in the queue.
agent.empty-title: Ask about a listing or your account
agent.empty-description: The agent reads charts, indicators and your paper account. It can suggest an order, and each one waits for you to confirm it.
agent.model-unavailable: {{model}} can't run: {{provider}} needs a key or sign-in, or is switched off. Pick another model, or set it up.
agent.setup-description: Pick a provider and save its API key, or sign in with ChatGPT, to start.

notices.error: The agent stopped with an error
notices.interrupted: Solyx closed before the agent finished.

link.title: Open this link?
link.description: It opens in your browser. The agent wrote it, so check the address first.

approval-mode.label: How should the agent's actions be allowed?

descriptions.ask: Tool calls and shell commands wait for you to allow them
descriptions.auto: Shell commands judged harmless run on their own, and pages this conversation found are read; everything else still asks
descriptions.bypass: Tool calls and shell commands run without waiting for you

approval-mode.auto-unjudged: Pages this conversation found are read; everything else still asks, shell commands too until you set up a decisions model
approval-mode.failed: Couldn't change how tools are allowed

approval.title: Allow this call?
approval.description: {{tool}} comes from an MCP server outside Solyx. Check what it's about to send.
approval.shell-description: This command runs on your computer with your access to its files and the network. Check it before you allow it.
approval.read-page-description: Your web search vendor will fetch this address. One you didn't expect could be a page the agent read trying to send your data out, so check it before you allow it.
approval.remember-description: The agent wants to keep this for later conversations, and reads it in every one. Check it says what you mean.
approval.forget-description: The agent wants to forget this memory, so later conversations won't know it.
approval.auto-allowed-found: allowed: an address this conversation found

welcome.title: Welcome to Solyx
welcome.description: An agent analyzes the market and proposes trades, and every order waits for you to confirm it. Market data, models and web search use your own keys, and data comes straight from each provider to this computer.

done.title: You're set
done.description: You can change any of this in Settings.
done.paper-note: Orders go to a paper account, so no real money moves.

restart.label: Setup guide
restart.description: Walk through Solyx's first-run setup again.

proposals.form-description: Proposals pass the risk checks here and again when you confirm them.
proposals.submit-failed: Submission failed; check your broker before placing it again
proposals.submit-interrupted: Solyx closed before the broker replied, so the order may have reached it.

research.title: Research
research.empty: No research yet. Ask the agent for a deep analysis to get a report and a forecast.

report.stale: A newer quarter, ending {{date}}, came out after this report was revised. The agent revises it before its next forecast.
report.quote-read: Quote read as stating it: {{share}} likely ({{model}})

forecasts.title: Forecasts
forecasts.record: {{settled, number}} of {{count, number}} settled · mean Brier {{brier}}

order-form.rationale-placeholder: Kept with the proposal for later review

risk.invalid-quantity-tw: Taiwan orders must be 1–999 odd-lot shares or a multiple of 1,000
risk.invalid-quantity-us: US orders must be a positive whole number of shares
risk.invalid-price: Price {{price, number(maximumFractionDigits: 4)}} is not a multiple of the {{tick, number(maximumFractionDigits: 4)}} tick size
risk.odd-lot-market-order: Odd-lot orders must be limit orders
risk.outside-price-band: Price is outside the daily limit band {{low, number}}–{{high, number}}
risk.missing-reference-price: Market orders need a last price to estimate their value
risk.order-too-large: Order value {{notional, number}} {{currency}} exceeds the {{max, number}} limit
risk.session-not-allowed: Orders are not allowed in the {{session}} session
risk.unsupported-market: The account does not trade {{market}} listings
risk.insufficient-cash: Order value {{notional, number}} {{currency}} exceeds the {{cash, number}} {{currency}} in the account
risk.insufficient-shares: Selling {{quantity, number}} shares, but the account holds {{held, number}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.language-description: Applies to the whole app and is kept on this computer.
settings.theme-description: System follows your computer's light or dark appearance.
settings.palette-description: Pick one for light and one for dark; the theme decides which one shows.

palette-editor.title: Edit {{name}}
palette-editor.name: Name
palette-editor.based-on: Starts from {{name}}; colors you haven't changed follow it.
palette-editor.preview-body: Muted text, such as hints and labels, reads like this.
palette-editor.delete-body: A light or dark appearance that uses it goes back to {{base}}.

settings.price-colors-description: By market follows each market's own convention: red for a rise in Taiwan, green in the US.

market-data.title: Market data
market-data.description: Keys and sign-in details are encrypted by your operating system (the Keychain on macOS, DPAPI on Windows), used only on this computer and never shown again.
market-data.source-description: Charts and live bars for Taiwan listings come from here. Set up the source you pick below.

source-hints.fugle: With your own Fugle API key.

market-data.limits: {{symbols, number}} live symbols; {{intraday, number}} intraday and {{historical, number}} history requests a minute

fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
fundamentals.description: Quarterly statements and monthly revenue for Taiwan listings come from FinMind, which needs no key. Requests go straight from this computer to FinMind.

secrets.unavailable: This computer has no secure storage, so keys and sign-in details can't be saved. On Linux, install and unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then restart Solyx.
secrets.unreadable: The saved value can't be decrypted on this computer anymore, for example after moving to another computer or user account. Enter it again.
secrets.replace-placeholder: Enter a new value to replace the saved one

fugle-api-key.label: API key
fugle-api-key.hint: The API key from your Fugle account.

fubon-personal-id.label: ID number
fubon-personal-id.hint: The ID number your account is under, e.g. A123456789.

fubon-api-key.label: API key
fubon-api-key.hint: A key from Fubon's API key page.

fubon-cert-password.label: Certificate password
fubon-cert-password.hint: Leave it unset if it's your ID number.

decisions-api-key.label: API key
decisions-api-key.hint: A key from the TypeSafe console.

cloudflare-api-key.label: API token
cloudflare-api-key.hint: A Cloudflare API token with the Workers AI permission on the account below.

openai-decisions-api-key.label: API key
openai-decisions-api-key.hint: An API key from the OpenAI platform; signing in with ChatGPT doesn't cover the Decisions API.

finmind-token.label: FinMind token
finmind-token.hint: FinMind answers without one, up to 300 requests an hour; a free account's token raises that to 600.

sign-in.continue-in-browser: Finish signing in in your browser; this page updates once it returns.

fugle.description: Market data with your own Fugle API key. Choose the plan the key belongs to; Solyx paces its requests and live symbols to that plan.

fubon.description: Market data through your Fubon Securities account, signed in with an API key and the certificate exported from Fubon's website. A key limited to market data can't place orders.

sdk.label: SDK folder
sdk.hint: The folder extracted from the Node.js SDK (fubon-neo-<version>.tgz) downloaded from Fubon.

certificate.label: Certificate
certificate.hint: The .pfx file exported from Fubon's website.

fubon.signed-out-hint: Solyx signs in when a Taiwan chart first needs data.

agent.title: AI agent
agent.description: Switch on the providers whose models you want to use, each on your own API key, or on your ChatGPT subscription for OpenAI. Requests go straight from this computer to the provider, or to the endpoint you set for it. Every conversation can pick its own model.
agent.default-description: Default model: what a conversation runs on until you pick another for it
agent.provider-is-default: The default model's provider, so it stays on
agent.auth-description: A subscription runs the agent on your plan's allowance instead of billing each request.
agent.endpoint-description: Change it only for a gateway that speaks this provider's own API. Your key is sent there too.
agent.endpoint-invalid: Enter an http or https URL

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT account
chatgpt.hint: Signs in through your browser, where OpenAI asks you to allow Solyx, then comes back here on its own.

agent.model-description: Larger models reason better and cost more per message.
agent.thinking-description: How long the model thinks before it answers. Models that don't reason ignore it.
agent.decision-mode-description: Who decides the agent's forecasts and order proposals. With the MAGI, three units each judge one as a side of a single mind (the scientist, the mother and the woman), and two votes carry it. Every vote costs three more requests to the conversation's model, and you still confirm every order.

personas.melchior: The scientist: what the data and the evidence show.
personas.balthasar: The mother: what could be lost, and whether standing aside is what the evidence called for.
personas.casper: The woman: what the crowd wants now, and what standing aside gives up.

web-search.title: Web search
web-search.description: Finds news articles and social posts for the news sources, and lets the agent search the web and read pages, on your own key. Requests go straight from this computer to the vendor.
web-search.in-use-description: In use: the vendor news and the agent search through

key-hints.firecrawl: A key from your Firecrawl dashboard. Firecrawl searches Google.
key-hints.exa: A key from your Exa dashboard. Exa searches its own index.
key-hints.tavily: A key from your Tavily dashboard. Tavily searches its own index; its news searches cannot favor a market's country.

news.title: News
news.description: The agent reads Taiwan companies' material announcements and PTT's Stock board on its own. Once web search is set up, it also searches news articles and samples posts on Threads in Taiwan and X in the US; each search uses the vendor's credits. Requests go straight from this computer to each source.
news.collect-every-description: How often each watched listing's news is collected while Solyx runs. With web search set up, every collection uses the vendor's credits; exchange announcements only reach back a day, so longer intervals miss some.

decisions.title: Decisions model
decisions.description: Answers typed questions with probabilities instead of written text, on your own key: it scores news and posts, checks the quotes the agent's research rests on, and judges shell commands in conversations set to Allow for me. These stay off until it is set up. Requests go straight from this computer to the provider.
decisions.in-use-description: In use: the provider whose model scores news, checks quotes and judges commands
decisions.account-id-description: The Cloudflare account whose Workers AI runs the model, shown on the account's overview page.

model-descriptions.typesafe: The model's id. The questions are measured against the default, so another version may judge texts differently.
model-descriptions.cloudflare: The model's id: clef, or the faster clef-flash. The questions are measured against the default, so the other may judge texts differently.
model-descriptions.openai: The model's id; gpt-6-luna is the only decisions model OpenAI offers so far.

decisions.base-url-description: Where requests go. Change it only for a proxy or a compatible service.
decisions.base-url-invalid: Enter an http or https URL

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Playbooks the agent reads when a task calls for one. Folders with a SKILL.md in {{skills}} are your own and come ahead of the built-ins. Skills in {{shared}}, shared with other agents, are offered only once you switch them on.
skills.instructions-description: Rules the agent keeps in every conversation, such as your risk budget, written in {{path}}. The whole file is sent with every message.
skills.warnings-title: Some skill files don't follow the Agent Skills format
skills.shell-description: Lets the agent run commands on this computer, which a skill needs to run its scripts. Every command waits for you to allow it unless you set a conversation to not ask. Commands are not sandboxed: one you allow can read and change your files and reach the network. Only works with a paper account.
skills.shell-label: Let the agent use the shell

memory.title: Memory
memory.description-text: What the agent keeps across conversations and reads in each one. It saves, rewrites or forgets a memory only once you allow it, and deleting a conversation keeps what it saved.
memory.enabled-description: The agent reads its memories in every conversation and asks before it saves, rewrites or forgets one. Switched off, they stay saved but go unused.
memory.empty: No memories yet. The agent asks before it saves one.
memory.secret: A memory can't hold a key, token, password or ID number

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Servers listed in {{path}}, in the mcpServers format Claude, Cursor and pi use. Write keys as secret:NAME and save them here, where your system encrypts them. Each call waits for you to allow it, unless you let a read-only tool run on its own.
mcp.empty: No servers yet. Add one to mcp.json and it connects here.
mcp.tally: {{off}} off, {{ask}} ask each time, {{auto}} run on their own
mcp.set-label: When the agent uses any of these {{count}} tools

sign-in.label: Account
sign-in.hint: Signs in through your browser, where the server asks you to allow Solyx. Solyx keeps the grant encrypted and never shows it.

candles.title: Candle cache
candles.description: Closed sessions are kept on this computer so charts don't download them again. After clearing, charts fetch them from your market data source when needed, which uses your plan's request budget.
candles.confirm-body: Charts will download closed sessions again as they need them. Your watchlist, proposals and settings stay.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Your conversations with the agent, and the folders their shell commands work in.
conversations.confirm-body: Their messages and the files their shell commands left are deleted from this computer, and any still running stops. This can't be undone. The orders they suggested stay in proposals.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: What the agent keeps across conversations, each memory saved once you allowed it.
memory.confirm-body: The agent starts its next conversation knowing nothing from earlier ones. This can't be undone. Your conversations stay.

news.title: News
news.description: Stories news sources found for your listings, and the decisions model's scores. Sources reach back only a few days, so older stories can't be collected again.
news.confirm-body: Stories and their scores are deleted from this computer, and older ones can't be collected again. Watched listings collect recent news at their next refresh.

research.title: Research
research.description: The agent's reports on your listings and its forecasts, with how each came out. None of it can be made again.
research.confirm-body: Every report and forecast is deleted from this computer, along with the record of how the forecasts came out. This can't be undone. Your conversations stay.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.description: The listings you watch, whose news is collected on a schedule.
watchlist.confirm-body: Every listing leaves the watchlist, and their news stops being collected on a schedule. This can't be undone. Their news and cached candles stay.

about.data-hint: Keys, databases and caches are kept here.
about.config-hint: You can also edit it by hand; saving applies the change.

signed-in.title: Signed in to ChatGPT
signed-in.body: You can close this tab and return to Solyx.

failed.title: ChatGPT was not connected
failed.body: Return to Solyx and try signing in again.

signed-in.title: Authorization sent to Solyx
signed-in.body: You can close this tab. Solyx finishes connecting the MCP server.

failed.title: The MCP server was not connected
failed.body: Return to Solyx and try signing in again.
